name: Metamorphose Candina
original_name: メタモルフォーゼ・キャンディーナ
source:
＊All girls can transform with candy＊

This is a story about girls who want to [i]transform[/i] their current selves and a mysterious candy shop.

A short branching visual novel where the ending you see changes depending on which visually enticing candy you choose to eat.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4804430/ReMetamorphosis_Candina/]Steam[/url]]
